Fakel welcome Dinamo Moskva to the Russian Premier League on Saturday, 7 November 2026. Kickoff is scheduled for 11:00 GMT. The venue for this fixture has not been officially confirmed at the time of writing. Dinamo Moskva arrive as strong favourites, sitting second in the table with 28 points from 13 matches, while Fakel occupy the bottom place with just six points from the same number of games. The match represents a critical opportunity for Fakel to gather points in their battle against relegation, whereas Dinamo Moskva will aim to maintain their push for the title and Champions League qualification.

Fakel, meanwhile, are rooted to the foot of the table with six points from 13 matches, five points adrift of the relegation play-off spot and seven from automatic safety. Three points for Fakel would provide a vital boost in their survival bid, while anything less would increase the pressure on the coaching staff. The fixture also carries significance in the head-to-head context: Dinamo Moskva have lost only once in the last eight meetings, though Fakel did win 2-0 at the Dinamo stadium in April 2023.

Dinamo Moskva have collected nine wins, one draw and three losses in 13 matches. They have scored 21 goals and conceded 12, averaging 1.62 goals per game and conceding 0.92 per game. Leeds United vs Tottenham Hotspur Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Leeds United welcome Tottenham Hotspur to Elland Road on Saturday, 7 November 2026, with kickoff scheduled for 12:30 GMT. The fixture is a mid-table Premier League encounter between two sides separated by a single point after nine matches. Leeds sit 12th with 11 points from two wins, five draws and two losses, while Tottenham occupy ninth place on 12 points with three wins, three draws and three defeats. Both teams have shown inconsistent form early in the campaign, making this a pivotal opportunity to climb toward the European qualification places.

The match will be played at Elland Road, Leeds United's historic home ground, which has hosted this fixture many times since the clubs' first meeting in 1920. With both defences conceding fewer than 1.2 goals per game on average, the contest could be decided by fine margins in attack.

Tottenham arrive with a slightly superior goal difference (0 to Leeds' +1) and a recent run of three wins in their last five league outings (WWWDL), while Leeds have managed only one victory in the same span (LDDLD).

For Tottenham, three points would consolidate their position as the highest-placed London club outside the traditional top six and maintain momentum under their current manager. For Leeds, a home victory over a recognised top-six aspirant would provide a significant confidence boost and alleviate early-season pressure. The fixture also carries historical weight: Tottenham have won three of the last five league meetings, including a 4-3 thriller at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in November 2022.
